title: The home screen: a globe to spin
kaylee: The old map is now a toy globe she spins with her finger. Every country is a pin with one big friendly thing on it (a moose, a pizza, a panda, an elephant), and Sparkle's balloon flies down to the one she taps.

links.label: The same with a mouse's words

pictures.title: The pins
pictures.caption: Your notes are in: a pizza for Italy, the elephant for Thailand, a bigger panda, polar bear and alpaca, and a moose for Canada. Egypt is as it was.

pictures.title: iPad
pictures.caption: Hand-drawn like the shelf, with each country's flag. No generated art, no emoji.

pictures.title: iPad, upright
pictures.caption: A globe is round, so it fills either way up. The map left half the screen empty.

pictures.title: iPhone
pictures.caption: Pins stay a full finger wide (64px here, 88px or more on the iPad).
